methodological_conclusion: Archive exhaustion is not a defensible requirement for lower-bound discovery. A bounded crawl can add candidates but cannot establish completeness or absence.
authorized_remediation: Create W2C-DISC-v2.0 that makes keyset channels bounded lower-bound discovery with explicit truncation telemetry; preserve the ten-family taxonomy, query dictionary, classifier and performance firewall.
prohibited_remediation: Do not change family terms or remove families based on counts; no family results existed in v1.0 or v1.1.
